messages:
marie_cs: Quick weekly healthbeat for NovaPay — focusing on p95/p99 by route & model, streaming vs sync. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/dashboards/nova-pay/weekly. Short summary: streaming /chat p95 ~140ms, p99 ~700ms; sync /chat p95 ~90ms, p99 ~260ms. Most concerning: model 'redwood-13b-quant' on streaming /assistant/respond hit p99 ~1.45s (large tail). Spend up ~22% WoW (~$15.5k). Renewal conversation in 10 days; flagging potential escalation.

dan_sre: Noted. Infra saw sustained high kernel latency around Thu 07:50-08:30 UTC. GPU mem pressure + preemptible instance churn on dedicated pool. We also observed batching depth spike coincident with the tail. Any recent runtime flags?

ravi_eng: We enabled "enable-cont-batch-opt" on the NovaPay pool Friday 08:15 UTC as a controlled experiment to improve throughput. It changes continuous-batching heuristics and switches a kernel path for KV-cache. Looks like mixed results — better average throughput but tailier for a subset of prompts. I can roll the flag back or narrow it to specific models. Example query I used to generate the percentile table: 

```sql
SELECT route, model, mode,
  approx_percentile(latency_ms, 0.95) AS p95,
  approx_percentile(latency_ms, 0.99) AS p99,
  count(*) AS samples
FROM metrics.latency
WHERE account_id = 'nova-pay' AND ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY route, model, mode
ORDER BY samples DESC
LIMIT 200;
```

olivia_sales: Renewal lead is worried — they requested assurance p99 < 500ms per route. They want before/after evidence if we change config. Please include cost impact in the notes.

ops-bot: Automated snapshot (pre-action): overall_streaming_p95=140ms; overall_streaming_p99=700ms; overall_sync_p95=90ms; overall_sync_p99=260ms; peak_model=redwood-13b-quant (streaming) p99=1.45s at Thu 08:07 UTC. Weekly spend=15.5k USD (+22% WoW). Link: https://redwood.app/metrics/snapshots/2991234567

marie_cs: Proposed runbook: 1) Narrow rollback: disable enable-cont-batch-opt for redwood-13b-quant only (safe) at 21:00 UTC tonight. 2) If tail persists, revert pool-wide. 3) Run evaluation set (200 streaming prompts + paired sync runs) and publish p95/p99 CSV. 4) Prepare renewal note with pre/post diff and cost delta. Can owners ack?

dan_sre: Ack. I'll schedule the targeted rollback 21:00 UTC and monitor GPU util, batch-depth, and p99 in a 30m validation window. Fallback: cap streaming batch_size to 6 if rollback has side effects.

ravi_eng: Ack. I'll prepare the eval harness and a short CSV of p95/p99 by route+model after the change. ETA EOD. Also will capture kernel traces for any anomalous runs.

olivia_sales: Ack on the timeline. If rollback reduces p99 below 500ms we can pause aggressive renewal pressure for 72h. I'll coordinate talking points.

ops-bot: Note: will post pre/post diffs automatically. Please tag me to trigger an ad-hoc snapshot: @ops-bot snapshot-now.

marie_cs: Action items (owners): marie_cs -> update NovaPay CSM record + renewal brief; dan_sre -> execute targeted rollback and post validation metrics; ravi_eng -> eval + traces; olivia_sales -> renewals comms; ops-bot -> publish snapshots. Please ping here with any regressions. Thanks everyone!
